title: I go to a place every night that I’ve never been
content: Every night I go to the same place which I know is mall world. It’s always the same plot line where I’m trying to get to the airport. The weird part is almost every dream has my ex in it that passed away in 2020. These dreams started after him dying. I’ve wondered if I’m going to a place in the astral where he can visit me. Maybe it’s hopeful thinking, but it is strange.
